content.title:
Class 11 or Class 12:
*when should IPM prep start?*
content.subtitle: Three common questions, answered simply.

qa.a: No. Many students start in Class 12. It means a tighter plan, because board exams sit in the middle of the year.

qa.q: What does starting in Class 11 change?
qa.a: More time to build speed slowly, take mocks early, and fix weak topics before boards arrive.

qa.q: How much time a day is enough?
qa.a: A steady hour or two on most days works better than long weekend sessions. Consistency beats intensity.
qa.note: Check each IIM's official website for this year's dates and eligibility.
